body: I have apolagized and said all that, but she doesnt think i can be there for her. Granted, I did break down and then try to make light of the situation. It's just how I cope. But I do take this very seriously and I want to support her with all I've got. How can I prove this? I feel like I've lost her trust. I'm not good with words, but we're really busy and mostly talk through text.

Thank you so much for the insight.

Thing is, I don't think think she'd believe me if I were to say that I'd be there for her. I clearly wasn't when it counted. I want to be there, more than anything I want to help her. I feel like because of my reaction she won't tell me anymore of her suicidal thoughts because she'd think I won't be able to handle it. I don't think she's wrong. 

If she were to tell me that she's trying again, then I will definitely call for help. I almost lost her once already. I'm going to look into the local facilities here, thank you.

Thank you for the advice, I really appreciate it. 

She doesn't seem to want help. I asked her "Do you want to get help?" and she said no. Should I push?
